name: Sellari Chiropractic Center
what_they_do: Single-doctor chiropractic practice at 1594 US-130 (Lake Farrington Plaza) that has served North Brunswick since 1989. Dr. Robert Sellari offers chiropractic adjustments, spinal decompression, EPAT shockwave-style therapy, cold laser, Graston and kinesio taping, focused on back/neck/headache/joint pain, plantar fasciitis and auto-accident/personal-injury recovery.
customers: Local adults and families with musculoskeletal pain, personal-injury and auto-accident claimants, athletes and plantar fasciitis/joint-pain patients in North Brunswick Township.

size_signals.signal: Sole practitioner (Dr. Robert Sellari); 'since 1989' stated in every page intro
Part-time clinic schedule - closed Tuesdays and Thursdays, Saturday mornings only
Google rating 4.9 and an active owner post (Veterans Day, published days before this review)

listing.reviews: count not displayed in the limited logged-out Maps view

website_review.primary_cta: 'Call (732) 821-5900' repeated across pages plus a 'click here' link to an Appointment Request page
website_review.online_booking_or_quote: Request only - the /appointment form says 'your appointment is not fully booked until you get a confirmation from us', with hours listed above the form. No live availability.
website_review.trust_signals: 37 years in practice, doctor-led care plan description, treatment pages for each modality, FAQ and auto-accident FAQ pages, 3D spine simulator, blog, published hours
website_review.out_of_date_signs: Content is refreshed (sitemap last modified 2026-11-10, active Google posts), but the site returned HTTP 403 Unauthorized to my Chrome browser, so I could not see the rendered design or mobile layout
website_review.search_basics: Page titles name chiropractor + North Brunswick Township, ~35 crawlable pages in the sitemap including per-condition and per-treatment pages; no schema.org JSON-LD at all (0 nodes) and hours appear only on the appointment page
top_issues: Home page returned 403 to a browser session, blocking visual review and possibly some crawlers
No structured data; hours missing from the home page
Booking is a request form followed by manual confirmation

agent_readiness.notes: Findable: robots.txt explicitly allows GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, PerplexityBot, Googlebot and ClaudeBot, and the GBP is actively maintained with recent owner posts; but the site answered my Chrome request with HTTP 403 Unauthorized (a plain HTTP fetch succeeded), which suggests datacenter/IP filtering - inference: AI crawlers on cloud IPs could be refused even though robots.txt says yes. Answerable: hours, address and phone are plain text on the appointment page and services are richly described, but there is no JSON-LD (0 nodes on the home page) and no prices. Bookable: appointment request form with a clear confirmation caveat = a callback, not a booking.

operations_signals.signal: Appointment requests must be confirmed by staff, and the form explicitly says the slot is not held until then - inference: front desk re-checks the calendar manually for every request
Two phone numbers are published ((732) 821-5900 and 821-7580) and the office is closed two weekdays, so missed-call handling matters
Personal-injury/auto-accident work is a stated specialty, which carries lien paperwork, insurance follow-up and progress documentation

top_opportunities.opportunity: Add LocalBusiness/Chiropractor JSON-LD with hours, address and services, and surface hours on the home page - currently zero structured data and hours live only on one subpage
top_opportunities.evidence: JSON-LD node count is 0 on the home page; hours (Mon/Wed/Fri split shifts, Sat morning, closed Tue/Thu) exist only on /appointment

top_opportunities.opportunity: Investigate and fix the HTTP 403 returned to browser clients, then confirm the site answers OAI-SearchBot/PerplexityBot - a blocked origin defeats the permissive robots.txt
top_opportunities.evidence: Browser navigation to https://www.sellarichiropractic.com/ and /index.html returned 403 Unauthorized, while a plain HTTP fetch returned full content

top_opportunities.opportunity: Replace the request-only form with real online scheduling against actual open slots, cutting the manual confirmation loop for a two-day-a-week-closed office
top_opportunities.evidence: 'your appointment is not fully booked until you get a confirmation from us' on the appointment page

scores.reasons: Gap: fresh content and an active profile, but no schema, no real booking and a 403 to browsers. Pay: 37-year single-doctor practice with insured and personal-injury patients - steady but small. Ease: schema and hours are a same-day fix; scheduling is a modest project. Evidence: full text of home/about/appointment pages and an active Google profile, but the browser was blocked so no visual or mobile review.
